{{short description|American physicist}}
'''Steven R. White''' is a professor of [[physics]] at the [[University of California, Irvine]]. He is a condensed matter physicist who specializes in the simulation of quantum systems.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Steven R. White |url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/steven-r-white-dtoy7n/ |access-date=2023-02-14 |website=www.nasonline.org}}</ref> He graduated from the [[University of California, San Diego]]; he then received his [[Ph.D.]] at [[Cornell University]], where he was a shared student with [[Kenneth G. Wilson|Kenneth Wilson]] and John Wilkins.<ref name=":1" />

He works mostly in condensed matter theory, specializing in computational techniques for strongly correlated systems.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2011-06-20 |title=Quantum leaper |url=https://news.uci.edu/2011/06/20/quantum-leaper/ |access-date=2023-02-14 |website=UCI News |language=en-US}}</ref> These strongly correlated systems include both high-temperature superconductors and [[Quantum spin liquid|quantum spin liquids]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-02-19 |title=Steven R. White |url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/people/steven-white/ |access-date=2023-02-14 |website=Simons Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref> He is most known for inventing the [[Density Matrix Renormalization Group]] (DMRG) in 1992.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=White |first=Steven R. |date=1992-11-09 |title=Density matrix formulation for quantum renormalization groups |journal=Physical Review Letters |volume=69 |issue=19 |pages=2863–2866 |doi=10.1103/PhysRevLett.69.2863|pmid=10046608 |bibcode=1992PhRvL..69.2863W }}</ref> This is a numerical variational technique for high accuracy calculations of the low energy physics of quantum many-body systems. His over one hundred seventy papers on this and related subjects have been used and cited widely—his most cited article has received over seven thousand citations.

== Awards ==
* National Science Foundation (NSF) Fellowship, 1982–1985
* Andrew D. White Supplementary Fellowship, 1982–1985
* IBM Postdoctoral Fellowship, 1988–1989
* American Physical Society, Fellow, 1998
* American Physical Society, Division Councilor for Computational Physics, 1999
* American Physical Society [[Aneesur Rahman]] Prize, 2003<ref name=":1">{{citation|url=http://www.aps.org/programs/honors/prizes/prizerecipient.cfm?first_nm=Steven&last_nm=White&year=2003|title=2003 Aneesur Rahman Prize for Computational Physics Recipient: Steven R. White|publisher=American Physical Society|accessdate=2016-04-20}}</ref>
* Fellow, [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (2008)
* Fellow, [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] (2016)<ref>{{citation|url=https://news.uci.edu/faculty/four-from-uci-elected-to-american-academy-of-arts-and-sciences/|newspaper=UCI News|publisher=University of California, Irvine|title=Four from UCI elected to American Academy of Arts and Sciences|date=April 20, 2016}}</ref>
* Physical Review Letters Milestone Paper of 1992 (Honored 2008)
* Perimeter Distinguished Visiting Research Chair (2012–present)
* Member, [[National Academy of Sciences]] (2018)<ref name=":0" />
